variants.headline: Company lays off many workers
variants.body: A company has laid off many workers in {colony}. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: A large loss of jobs at a company
variants.body: Many workers have been laid off by a company in the colony. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: Workers face a company layoff
variants.body: The colony has seen a company carry out a large layoff. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
